activity.notes: Theodoric the Great (Theoderic in much modern scholarship) secured sole rule in Italy after Odoacer's death in 493 and ruled until his death in 526. ATLAS binds him to the Ostrogothic Kingdom as the durable Gothic political authority he established in Italy, rather than to the Roman Empire or to a generic Italy polity.

sources.title: Theoderic (1), Gothic king of Italy, 493–526 CE — Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: Oxford Classical Dictionary identifies Theoderic, also spelled Theodoric and known as the Great, as Gothic king and ruler of Italy from 493 until his death in 526.
